title: A helper changes a member
prompt: `health` is a variable at the top of the script (a member variable) starting at 100. The robot takes a hit of 30 through a `take_damage` helper, and health_after_hit reports what is left: 70.
hints: take_damage takes an amount and subtracts it from health; health_after_hit calls take_damage(30) and then returns health. Because health is a member, a helper can change it and health_after_hit sees the change.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
